admin.codigos.dica: The technician suggests the codes when completing the work order, and whoever accepts it confirms them. Type and category cannot change after creation: to change them, create a new code and deactivate the old one.
admin.codigos.vazio: No codes. Install the defaults or create one.
admin.configuracao.codigos.ligado: Require failure, cause and solution on acceptance
admin.configuracao.codigos.resumo: {ligado, select, true {On: acceptance requires all three codes} other {Off}}
admin.configuracao.codigos.dica: In the technician app, codes are always a suggestion: completion is never refused for lack of them.
admin.configuracao.foto_depois.ligado: Require at least one after photo to complete
admin.configuracao.foto_depois.resumo: {ligado, select, true {On: completion requires an after photo} other {Off}}
admin.configuracao.foto_depois.dica: The technician marks each photo as before or after in the app. When on, the work order can only be completed with at least one after photo.
admin.configuracao.assinatura.ligado: Require the signature of the person accepting
admin.configuracao.assinatura.resumo: {ligado, select, true {On: acceptance requires a signature} other {Off}}
admin.configuracao.assinatura.dica: The person accepting draws the signature on the screen, and it is kept with the work order. It is evidence of acceptance, not an ICP-Brasil digital signature.
tecnico.os.codigos.dica: A suggestion for whoever accepts the work. You can leave it blank: completion does not depend on it.
erro.codigos_so_admin: Only the group Admin manages maintenance codes.

erro.foto_depois_obrigatoria: In this hotel, completion requires at least one photo taken after the work.
erro.assinatura_obrigatoria_no_aceite: In this hotel, acceptance requires the signature of the person accepting.

inteligencia.lista.modulo: Optional module, subscribed by this group. It turns maintenance data into decisions: which assets fail and cost the most, what changed after an intervention, and where to act first. Every result shows where it came from. Correlation is never presented as cause.
inteligencia.abertura.nota: Intelligence calculates from the day the module is activated, but its screens only appear from the opening date and only for the chosen roles. Until then, detected insights are kept, with no owner. Only the Group admin sees this page.
inteligencia.abertura.estado.valor: {abertas, select, true {Screens open} other {Screens not open yet}}
inteligencia.abertura.sem_contrato: No date: the group has no module contract to count the days from.
inteligencia.abertura.origem.data: Date set by the Group admin
inteligencia.abertura.origem.ativacao: {dias, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the module was first activated ({ativacao})
inteligencia.abertura.campo.data_ajuda: Leave blank to count the days from the first activation. The day starts at midnight in the group's time zone.
inteligencia.lista.rodape: An insight suggests where to look; a person decides. A possible systemic problem has no score and falls in the Attention band. You only see insights whose hotels you can fully see.
inteligencia.indicador.abertos_detalhe: No final decision yet, within your scope.
inteligencia.indicador.alta_detalhe: In the High attention and Critical bands.
inteligencia.indicador.sistemicos_detalh: The same problem in several places.

inteligencia.escopo.rede_grupo: {quantidade, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} in the group
inteligencia.pagina.substitui: This insight replaces an earlier one.
inteligencia.pagina.substituido: Replaced by an insight that includes more hotels.
inteligencia.pagina.atencao_resumo: Attention {valor} at the last detection ({faixa}); the insight opens from {limite}. What weighed most:
inteligencia.aviso.sinal: This is a signal, not a conclusion: the same problem in several places may point to the model, the area or the supplier. Only a person confirms it.
inteligencia.aviso.score: The score shows what weighed, not the cause. The decision to repair or replace belongs to the team.
inteligencia.aviso.score_ativo: The score shows what weighed, not the cause. The decision to repair or replace belongs to the team, on the insight page.

inteligencia.decisao.nao_decide: You don't decide on this insight. You can follow the evidence.
inteligencia.decisao.silencio: “Not relevant” silences this problem for 30 days, unless the band goes up.
